verdict.rationale: GA4's own marketing claims an interface for collaboration with "shareable reports" [docs-39], and a community user notes custom reports can be built in 'Explore' [comm-16]. That is GA4's own reporting-and-sharing capability, but the evidence is a single thin claim. The Data API's "build custom dashboards" [docs-2] is a developer building block, and Looker Studio via BigQuery is a separate product, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: documented native dashboard composition from saved reports/insights, team sharing and permission details for dashboards, first-party docs depth, hands-on corroboration.
